candidate.prediction_execution_reason: V2-05 selected the V2-03 specification, but current supervised branch weights are cross-fitted fold checkpoints rather than one final all-development deploy fit.

missingness.genomics_unavailable: zero genomic embedding contribution, genomic_available=0, genomic_age_scaled=0
missingness.optional_stream_missing: preserve missingness explicitly; do not infer negative disease findings

old_external_rule: Completed DFCI/VICC outcomes/predictions remain historical legacy evidence only and are not V2 confirmation.
outcome_reveal_rule: No new-cohort outcomes may be inspected until Stage-B predictions and their hashes are immutable.

primary_evaluation.center_reporting: report each center separately; pooled summary is descriptive only unless separately prespecified
primary_evaluation.legacy_comparator: checkpoint7r3b bounded repaired legacy candidate when the new-cohort input contract permits

prohibited: DFCI/VICC outcome reuse for V2 selection or confirmation
inspection of new-cohort outcomes before primary prediction freeze
changing eligibility, predictor mapping, missingness policy, horizons, nuisance estimation, or metrics after outcome inspection
using a single CV fold checkpoint as the final deploy model
treatment-line identity as a model-facing predictor or landmark-membership rule
